about: Leaf textures a mod ships in an unnatural colour, laid again at the same path recoloured (tools/newworld/world/recolour.py, run by infra/gpu-box/stack.py stage into the folder argonia-recolours, above every mod; nothing here is a game file). hue: degrees added; sat, val: factors. Judged off-game against the owner's screenshot and the neighbouring trees' leaves (docs/phases/new-worldspace-plan/walk2/flora.md). The tree billboards follow at the next TexGen run.

textures\\plants\\tamira\\newplants\\bam.why: King of the Murkmire's bamboo (ArgoniaTreeBamboo01, 02) leaves are hue 136, saturation 0.55: turquoise in game (hue 151 in the owner's picture); its neighbours' leaves are hue 70 to 103
